message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel line chart comparing Solve and Propose training trajectories for reward and token length.","description":"A two-panel line chart with Training Steps on the horizontal axes, labeled at 0, 40, 80, 120, 160, 200, 240, and 280. The legend identifies Solve with a purple line and Propose with a salmon-pink line. The left panel plots Reward on a vertical scale from 0.0 to 1.0 and has a small gray “Deduction Task” label beneath it. Solve rises quickly to an early peak near 0.75, declines toward roughly 0.4–0.5, then fluctuates sharply late in training, with peaks near 0.8 and 1.0 and an ending value around 0.25. Propose generally climbs from zero to around 0.5, then varies strongly late in training, dipping close to zero and reaching about 0.6 before ending near 0.5. The right panel plots Token Length, with a right-side vertical axis labeled from 400 to 1400. Solve begins around 350–400, dips early, briefly spikes near step 70, then rises to a broad plateau around 700–750 before climbing steeply after about step 200 to above 1300. Propose begins around 700, drops to roughly 250–300 early, briefly rebounds, and thereafter fluctuates mostly around 300–450, ending near 360. Values in chart_values are estimated read-offs; the plotted lines end around step 270, before the 280
